# githubsettings_repository_oidc_subject_template (Resource)

Manages the OpenID Connect subject template for GitHub Actions in one repository. Creating or updating this resource applies the configured template to GitHub; destroying it removes the resource from Terraform state without changing the template. Requires a token with repository administration write access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "githubsettings_repository_oidc_subject_template" "example" {
  owner                 = "example-owner"
  repository            = "example-repository"
  use_default           = false
  use_immutable_subject = true
  include_claim_keys    = ["repo", "context"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `owner` (String) GitHub account that owns the repository or organization.
- `repository` (String) GitHub repository name within the owner account.
- `use_default` (Boolean) Use GitHub's default subject claim template.
- `use_immutable_subject` (Boolean) Use an immutable subject claim.

### Optional

- `include_claim_keys` (List of String) Ordered claim keys to include in the subject. Omit when use_default is true.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import githubsettings_repository_oidc_subject_template.example example-owner/example-repository
```
